lead_independence.lead: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast in Palm City is now caring for over 100 animals connected to two separate hoarding investigations in Stuart and Palm City. lead_independence.lead: Nathan Hsu was arrested Sunday after deputies say he fired through a locked door with a woman on the other side and fled. The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office said deputies responded around 11:30 a.m. on August 16 to a home in the 1700 block of Wyoming Avenue for a domestic disturbance. Investigators said Hsu was involved in an argument with a woman who locked herself inside a bathroom, prompting Hsu to fire a round through the door before taking off in a getaway car.
